acceptance.text: Anonymous appearance choices apply locally and never call learner profile persistence.
Authenticated appearance loads from the learner profile and saves theme, font size and density through the visible UI to PostgreSQL.
Server save failures are not presented as saved; success is shown only after an OK response.
Concurrent appearance updates are serialized so an older response can never overwrite newer choices or report the newest save complete.
Neither a late profile GET nor auth-provider loading may replace a newer learner choice; a choice made while auth is loading is saved after authentication resolves.

spec.expected_behavior: BFF forwards GET/PUT with learner session and Origin, Go session+CSRF checks remain effective, and the client reports saved only after HTTP success.
spec.observed_behavior: AppearanceSettingsClient issues GET and debounced PUT to /api/auth/me, but the Next BFF exports GET only and the client marks any HTTP response as saved.

red_targets.test: forwards authenticated appearance updates and the CSRF Origin to Go
AppearanceSettingsClient > does not show saved after the profile endpoint rejects the update
AppearanceSettingsClient > serializes saves so an older response cannot overwrite the newest choice
AppearanceSettingsClient > does not replace a learner choice when the initial profile request resolves late
AppearanceSettingsClient > persists a learner choice made while auth is loading instead of replacing it with the profile
